fibreInventory.warning: The accepted 80-fibre target is not a bijection derived from counts of cells or coordinate ports. Four directional record labels are not eighty fibre identities.

workingChoice.meaning: Use the operator-chosen {2,2} family without selecting a labelled representative.
workingChoice.proposedIncidenceTemplate: For a declared triple (T,U,V), where T is the selected occurrence of the paired-tip group with both members active and U,V carry the P/P and E/E pairs, T shares an actual native edge with U and with V.
workingChoice.edge3Acceptance: The incidence predicate must select exactly the eight retained working candidates and exclude the eight control candidates, without inspecting their distance class.
workingChoice.scope: A proposed placement condition. Edge sharing is not authorization for an N-to-N passage, and no instance of this template is automatically assigned to each cone.

globalConstraints: Specify one complete carrier-wide assignment before local reader checks; do not construct routes by extending admissible readers.
Retain every native cell, edge, face, required interior site and original provenance. Distinguish unused sites from deleted geometry.

Bind fibre identities and their boundary occurrences before solving. Partition named fibre instances disjointly and regroup with an inverse; repeated references are not automatically new fibre instances.
Use actual shared-face and declared internal passages. Opposite-tip grouping alone does not authorize teleportation.
Include all 44 overlapping comparison cones and explicit external context; do not treat them as independent copies of the entrance cone.
Distinguish availability of a geometric comparison path from an obligation to execute it as a wire.
Require exact forward/reverse recovery on the declared state domain and retain the assignment and its histories.
Do not import period-four closure, lexical endpoint matching, a shortest-path selector or a native phase law from another candidate.
solverGate: Do not run a routing solver until fibre/port and passage/placement bindings are specified. Missing bindings mean not formulated, not no solution.
allowedOutcomes: complete structurally verified assignment under explicit assumptions
